[{"insert":"Bench Press

The barbell bench press is the primary horizontal press of this cycle. Keep the shoulder blades pinched together and down throughout the set.  This protects the shoulder and creates a more stable pressing platform. The 20X1 tempo means controlled descent, no pause, then drive. Reps drop across the odd weeks, so the weight goes up each time it returns.
"}]
